reviews.text: Competent and friendly staff. Thanks from me and my cat Juan.
They are super professional and very kind. Dr. Alessandro is the best. Ringo thanks him and his family too.
They looked after my cat very well, both in the emergency room and for subsequent treatments and checkups. Special thanks to the surgeon Dr. Frigieri. Thank you from me and Floki!

Dr. Valentina is an exceptional person who works with professionalism and passion for all animals, and is also very fair in her pricing. Giulia at the front desk is also very sweet and available for advice.
Kind and knowledgeable staff, clean and spacious rooms, Dr. Cirillo friendly and good

The facility and staff are top notch. For years, they have been my go-to place for my four-legged friends and their furry friends. They are professional, knowledgeable, and have great empathy. They have managed to solve problems that other facilities couldn't. Thank you all!

My experience was brief due to a small problem, but I plan to continue using the clinic's medical services.
The doctor is very kind.
Convenient parking.
Welcoming, patient and good with animals
Great professionals with big hearts. I highly recommend them. They're a safe haven for our furry friends.

Thanks to the vets at this clinic, our Maltese Moki returned home with his family. They saved his life and even today, while they are treating him, they treat him with love. Thanks to all of them from Grandma Adriana.

Five stars is not enough. Thank you for your patience, humanity, attention, and care for these wonderful creatures.
Thank you so much.
Always available and above all competent!

Moky teaches us to never knock on just one door. In fact, the private clinic where he was admitted, before meeting the doctors at Prima Porta, had given him up for dead. Today, however, he's here with us, happy and barking as ever, thanks to kind, honest, and caring veterinarians who absolutely didn't profit from a tragedy (he was attacked by two pit bulls during a walk). Unlike the clinic that gave my two-year-old dog up for dead with a staggering fee as consolation... But life teaches us, and history teaches us. Remember that there's always someone honest and professional, and ironically, this time we found them not by knocking on the first door, but on the second.
I will never go there again, I don't like it especially the doctor, for goodness sake, I found him cold and without empathy
